title: 第23章 学生钱真好赚
novel_title: 巫师：让你学知识，你杀穿万界？
content_zh:
时间一分一秒流逝。

    不知过了多久。

    光幕上的画面突然停顿。

    那个温和的女声再次响起：

    “第一课：字母与发音，已完成。共掌握基础字母56个，基础发音56个。”

    “第二课‘字母组合与拼读’，即将开始。”

    ......

    当肚子饿了的时候，伊森才意识到自己不知不觉已经完成了5个课时的学习。

    他活动了一下有些僵硬的脖子，目光扫过光幕上显示的进度条。

    第三课“简单词语构成”才开了个头。

    按照这个进度，后续5个课时下来，他堪堪学完四课内容。

    伊森的目光落在那张长长的课程列表上。

    巫师语基础、进阶、巫师语精通。

    还有符文写作、古巫师语解析、语源学、咒文结构学......

    密密麻麻，加起来小一百课。

    他嘴角忍不住抽动了一下。

    自己已经是百倍的学习速度了，5个课时才推进到第三课。

    这要是换成普通人......

    而这，仅仅是语言。

    后面还有符文入门、巫术模型解析、材料辨识......每一门课都要魔石，每一门课都要大量的课时。

    伊森忽然有点理解血怒那番话的意思了。

    十年淘汰九成。

    这哪是淘汰，分明是筛选。

    筛掉没天赋的，筛掉不努力的，更筛掉没资源的。

    每一步都要魔石。

    没魔石怎么办？

    打工。

    血怒说得很清楚，学院里有无数工作。

    扫地的，洗碗的，喂魔兽的，整理材料的，当实验助手的，替老师跑腿的。

    只要肯干，饿不死。

    但饿不死，不等于能活过十年。

    那些工作的报酬伊森虽然还不知道具体数字，但用脚趾头想也能猜到，肯定高不到哪去。

    一个小时能赚多少？

    零点几块魔石？

    一天干十个钟头，赚几块魔石？

    够学几个课时？

    够买几份材料？
content_en:
Time passes minute by minute.

    I don’t know how much time passed.

    The picture on the light screen suddenly stopped.

    The gentle female voice sounded again:

    "Lesson 1: Letters and Pronunciations has been completed. A total of 56 basic letters and 56 basic pronunciations have been mastered."

    "The second lesson, 'Letter Combinations and Spelling', is about to begin."

    ...

    When he was hungry, Ethan realized that he had completed 5 hours of study without knowing it.

    He moved his somewhat stiff neck and glanced at the progress bar displayed on the light screen.

    The third lesson "Simple Word Formation" has just begun.

    According to this progress, in the next five classes, he will be able to finish four lessons.

    Ethan's eyes fell on the long list of courses.

    Basic, advanced, and proficient wizarding language.

    There are also rune writing, ancient wizard language analysis, etymology, spell structure...

    Densely packed, it adds up to a hundred lessons.

    The corners of his mouth couldn't help but twitch.

    I have already learned a hundred times faster, and I only advanced to the third lesson after 5 lessons.

    If this were an ordinary person...

    And this is just language.

    Later, there are introduction to runes, analysis of witchcraft models, material identification... Each course requires magic stones, and each course requires a lot of class hours.

    Ethan suddenly understood the meaning of Blood Rage's words.

    Ninety percent will be eliminated in ten years.

    This is not elimination, it is clearly screening.

    Screen out those who have no talent, screen out those who do not work hard, and screen out those who have no resources.

    Every step requires magic stones.

    What to do if there is no magic stone?

    work to earn a living.

    Blood Rage made it very clear that there are countless jobs in the academy.

    Those who sweep the floor, wash dishes, feed monsters, organize materials, serve as lab assistants, and run errands for teachers.

    As long as you work hard, you will never die of hunger.

    But not dying of hunger does not mean that you can live for more than ten years.

    Although Ethan doesn't know the exact figure of the remuneration for those jobs, he can guess it with his toes. It's definitely not much higher.

    How much can you earn in an hour?

    A few tenths of magic stone?

    How many magic stones can you earn by working ten hours a day?

    How many classes are enough?

    How many materials are enough to buy?
title_en: Chapter 23 Student money is so easy to make
